title: Replay (v1)
description: A finished session as one document: the session as it started, then every server message in order. Enough to rebuild the timeline, scoreboard and event feed without running the game; not a frame-by-frame recording, which needs the backend's own state stream.

session.description: The session when it started running.

messages.description: Server messages only, ordered by seq. Client requests are left out: what counted is what the server sent on.
